This is the MR-RATE-atlas repository, part of the MR-RATE dataset release. It contains atlas-registered MRI volumes in which all imaging sequences within each study have been spatially normalized to a standard atlas-space. For full dataset details, native-space MRI volumes, radiology reports, metadata, and data splits, please refer to… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Forithmus/MR-RATE-atlas.
